description: This class includes the manufacture of structural metal products for use in construction and civil engineering.
includes: manufacture of metal frameworks or skeletons for construction and parts thereof: bridges, bridge sections, towers, lattice masts, roofs, roofing frameworks, doors, windows
manufacture of industrial frameworks in metal: frameworks for blast furnaces, lifting and handling equipment
manufacture of prefabricated buildings mainly of metal
manufacture of metal containers for compressed or liquefied gas
manufacture of shuttering for concrete constructional work
manufacture of metal cable for use in construction
manufacture of metal doorframes and window frames, doors, shutters, gates
manufacture of metal storage bins, tanks and containers
manufacture of metal stairs, fire escapes, grilles
manufacture of pillars and columns of metal
excludes: manufacture of tanks and reservoirs, see 2512
manufacture of boilers and pressure vessels, see 2513
manufacture of metal cables, braided wire etc., see 2592
